reason: The stems are fading, so I want to lift the crop into the basket for sorting and eating.
expectation: I expect to harvest potatoes from the trough, though I don't know how much sorting happens yet.

alternatives.reason: Watering is possible, but the introduction suggests the crop is ready to lift.

effect: The harvest is available now, so I can separate seed stock and prepare food.
reaction: The image of lifting the pale potatoes one at a time is satisfying after the long wait.
reason: I want to set aside healthy stock for another planting before preparing the meal.
expectation: I expect the potatoes to be sorted into seed and eating portions, though I don't know the criteria yet.

alternatives.reason: Washing would start the meal, but I want to attend to the seed goal first.

effect: Seed stock is selected; I can now focus on the meal.
reaction: Clear progress, though I am curious how healthy seed potatoes were chosen.
reason: Washing the lifted potatoes is a natural preparation for cooking them.
expectation: I expect clean potatoes ready for cutting or cooking.

effect: The potatoes are clean and ready for preparation.
reason: Cutting the washed potatoes is the natural next cooking preparation.
expectation: I expect cut potatoes that can be seasoned or baked.

effect: The potatoes are cut; oil is available for the next cooking step.
reaction: Another expected preparation step, with little surprise.
reason: Coating the cut potatoes with oil seems appropriate before using the oven.
expectation: I expect oiled potatoes ready to roast.

effect: The oiled pieces are ready for the oven.
reaction: The preparation is familiar, though a little procedural.
reason: The oven should turn the prepared pieces into the larger harvest meal.
expectation: I expect roasted potatoes and completion of the tasting goal.

effect: The roasting completed the meal and both chapter goals.
reaction: The quiet radio hiss makes the meal feel solitary and lived-in; I like that detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting the potatoes was satisfying: the pale crop larger than the seed pieces paid off the long growing period.

leastWorthwhile.text: Washing, cutting, and oiling were sensible but a rather predictable sequence with little discovery between actions.

surprise.text: The quiet radio hiss during the meal gave the ending an unexpectedly lonely feeling.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though selecting healthy seed stock happened without explaining the selection criteria, which left me curious.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue for the larger story and the fate of the discovery, though this chapter's cooking sequence alone offered limited decisions.
